name: Crimson Creek
source:
Crimson Creek is a short visual novel with slice-of-life, mystery and horror elements mixed in. You play as a pair of boyfriends, Terry and Shane, as they go on a seemingly normal camping trip in the Pine Barrens, but end up coming face to face with the Jersey Devil, and decide to go and try to film it for views on Pawtube. The come to find that they are majorly out of their depth.

[From [url=https://hollowfox7.itch.io/crimson-creek]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Crimson Creek》是一部融合了生活片段、神秘和恐怖元素的视觉短篇小说。你扮演一对男友Terry和Shane，他们在松林贫瘠之地进行看似正常的露营旅行，但最终与泽西恶魔面对面，并决定去尝试拍摄它以在Pawtube上观看。他们逐渐发现自己已经超出了自己的能力范围。

[来自[url=https://hollowfox7.itch.io/crimson-creek]Itch.io[/url]]
